name: CaterCraft — Catering & Event Orders
description: Quote, plan, produce and deliver catering jobs: manage clients and menu packages, move jobs through an event pipeline, run the production board, dispatch deliveries, and track dietary requirements. Includes 6 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: CaterCraft — Catering & Event Orders
packMeta.description: Quote, plan, produce and deliver catering jobs: keep clients and a menu package library, move every job through the pipeline, run kitchen production by station, dispatch delivery runs and confirm dietary requirements — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Client
forms.description: Add a catering client with their organisation, contact details and billing address.

fields.label: New Client
fields.description: Capture who is ordering so every quote, job and invoice lands with the right person.

properties.placeholder: Favourite menus, invoicing quirks, tastings booked…

forms.title: Menu Package
forms.description: Define a menu package with its category, per-person price, minimum guests and the diets it supports.

fields.label: New Menu Package
fields.description: Build the library your quotes come from — price it per person and note the diets it covers.

properties.placeholder: e.g. Executive Lunch, Harvest Grazing Table
What is on the menu and how it is served…

forms.title: Catering Job
forms.description: Log a catering job linking the client with the event, guest count, service type, venue and pipeline status.

fields.label: New Catering Job
fields.description: Start with the enquiry — everything else in the kitchen and on the road hangs off this job.

forms.title: Production Task
forms.description: Add a kitchen production task for a catering job, assigned to a station with a due date and status.

fields.label: New Production Task
fields.description: Break the job into station work — the board tracks what is done, due and blocked.

properties.placeholder: Recipe notes, batch sizes, allergens to watch…

forms.title: Delivery Run
forms.description: Schedule a delivery run for a catering job with driver, vehicle, pickup and delivery times, and proof on arrival.

fields.label: New Delivery Run
fields.description: Put the job on the road — who is driving, in what, and when it leaves the kitchen.

properties.placeholder: Gate codes, loading dock, who signed…

forms.title: Dietary Requirement
forms.description: Record a dietary requirement for a catering job with the guests affected and kitchen confirmation.

fields.label: New Dietary Requirement
fields.description: Note every diet the kitchen must cater for — nothing gets plated until it is confirmed.

properties.placeholder: Severity, cross-contact rules, who it is for…

apps.name: CaterCraft
apps.description: A catering operations hub: keep clients and a menu package library, move every job through the pipeline, run the kitchen by station, dispatch delivery runs and confirm dietary requirements from one dashboard.

roles.name: Catering Manager
roles.description: Full access to every catering form.

roles.name: Kitchen Lead
roles.description: Runs production: works jobs and tasks, confirms dietary requirements, references the menu.

roles.name: Delivery Driver
roles.description: Sees confirmed jobs and updates the delivery runs they are on.

blocks.title: Catering operations overview
blocks.body: This report summarises the catering pipeline from enquiry to close. Use it to track how jobs move through each status, which service types are in demand, the value sitting in the pipeline and where production effort is concentrated across events.
